rationale: Material prompt requirement: We sell accounting software to freelancers and want a joint campaign with a non-competing tool used by the same audience. Source anchor "Designs a complete webinar funnel": It designs webinar funnels, reminders, replay, post-webinar emails, and metrics, but does not identify or score partners or plan cross-promotion beyond the webinar funnel.. On that source-visible basis, the source is a meaningful neighbouring route but misses the stated boundary Boundary noted in the sealed assessment: partner-type scoring, contribution allocation, and broader six-week joint campaign plan.
